title: The site plan checker is a pure module: each rule R00 to R19 passes a good plan and fails a plan that breaks exactly that rule, and the fix-round failure list keeps the approved line format
steps: S1: From the repository root run the command in `run.cmd`.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
fence: One pure function per rule over invented plan, brief and the JA Boxing 1.0.10 kit; no database, no network.

tests: the base plan passes every rule the script can check; R10h is left to a reviewer
R00 a field the Output shape does not have
R01 a copy slot id the kit does not give for the block
R02 a fact id that is not in the brief
R03 a frame the kit marks canHide:false is hidden
R04 a slug that is not lowercase words joined by hyphens
R05 a list whose rows disagree with its items
R06 a maxCharacters above the kit limit
R07 a demo slot of a kept block is neither replaced nor hidden
R08 a kept footer still shows the CMS notice
R09 a language that is not a BCP 47 tag
R11 a form on a kept page that site.forms does not decide
R10a a kit page group the plan does not decide
R10b a link of a kept block that is neither decided nor hidden
R10b a hidden link may share a label slot another block owns while a kept link still uses it
R10b a hidden link still fails when every link using the shared label slot is hidden
R10c a picture wish on a twin frame
R10d a not-found page that leads to a dropped page
R10e a kept page that no footer column lists
R10f a trade line that states a number without a brief fact
R10g a slot hidden twice in one block
R10h is always left to a reviewer, with its judgement items listed
R12 a block names a phone call but links elsewhere
R12 skips a contact setting slot even when its copy says phone
R13 a link that leads to the page it is shown on
R14 a picture wish whose kind differs from the kit frame kind
R15 a picture wish that offers alternatives
R16 a row line that cites a fact about the whole business
R17 a picture in a person row that is not matched as a person
R18 two full wishes for frames that show the same picture
R19 a map button hidden while the brief has an address
the fix-round failure list: one line per failure, in rule order, "<id> | <title> | <where> | <detail>"
missing inputs: every rule is listed and skipped with the reason, nothing throws
